static.screenshot: Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms; [System.Windows.Forms.Screen]::PrimaryScreen | ForEach-Object { $bitmap = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap($_.Bounds.Width, $_.Bounds.Height); $graphics = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($bitmap); $graphics.CopyFromScreen($_.Bounds.Location, [System.Drawing.Point]::Empty, $_.Bounds.Size); $path = [System.IO.Path]::Combine([Environment]::GetFolderPath('Desktop'), 'screenshot_' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss') + '.png'); $bitmap.Save($path); Write-Output "Screenshot saved to $path" }

_comment_browser: === BROWSER NAVIGATION (v3.2) === All browser commands in one place. These are handled by parser.py key_map and _match_navigation/_match_result_click. Supported in Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Brave — any Chromium-based or standard browser.

browser_navigation._info: These commands work in ANY active browser window. They are executed via keyboard shortcuts (pyautogui), not PowerShell.
